editorial.blurb: Carbon Live Fire Mexican Grill serves vibrant, fresh Mexican fare with live-fire cooking that keeps customers coming back for more.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the pastor burrito (it sells out frequently), ask for the roasted red pepper creamy sauce on the side, and try the flour tortilla chips — and remember the Marshfield location is BYOB.

topDishes.note: Sells out often; customers rave it's deliciously fresh and worth the wait
